strings.name: Penélope Cruz
strings.summary: Cruz moved from ballet training and Spanish cinema into an international career between Almodóvar’s female characters and English-language productions. Volver and Parallel Mothers examine family and memory; Vicky Cristina Barcelona earned a supporting-actress Oscar. Comedy, drama and genre work connect Spanish film with international audiences.
